suggestedTagsThreshold.label: Suggested Tags Min Score
suggestedTagsThreshold.description: Minimum confidence score (0–100) an AI-suggested tag must reach before it is shown to the user.

embedThreshold.label: Embedding Similarity Threshold
embedThreshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0.0–1.0) for an article to be included in search results.

keywordFallbackEnabled.label: Keyword Fallback
keywordFallbackEnabled.description: Fall back to keyword matching when the local embedding model is offline.

cacheTtlMinutes.label: RSS Cache TTL
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long (in minutes) fetched RSS feeds are cached in memory before re-fetching.

maxArticlesPerFeed.label: Max Articles per Feed
maxArticlesPerFeed.description: Maximum number of articles fetched from each RSS feed (most recent first). If a source publishes more items than this, the older ones are dropped before any date filtering runs — raise this if "Week" or "All Time" looks incomplete for a high-volume feed.

maxSuggested.label: Max Keyword Suggestions
maxSuggested.description: Maximum number of trending keywords returned by the AI keyword suggestion endpoint.

maxTitlesForAI.label: Max Headlines Sent to AI
maxTitlesForAI.description: Maximum number of RSS headlines sent to the AI for keyword extraction. Lower values are safer for smaller models; higher values give better coverage.

thumbnailSize.label: Article Thumbnail Size
thumbnailSize.description: Size of article thumbnail images shown in search results, previews, and clippings.
